_comment: Anthropic API list prices, USD per million tokens. Source: platform.claude.com model overview + pricing, verified 2026-07-08. cacheWriteMultiplier/cacheReadMultiplier are applied to the model's input rate (Anthropic's standard prompt-caching structure): 5-min cache write = 1.25x input, 1-hour = 2x input, cache read = 0.1x input. Match is by longest model-id prefix, so dated snapshots (…-20251101) resolve to their family. Local / non-Anthropic models (glm, qwen, gemma, kimi, ollama) are absent on purpose — they cost nothing on the subscription and are reported as unpriced.
